recent_posts.title: Micronaut 5.0.0-M3 Released!
recent_posts.summary: Micronaut 5.0.0-M3 has been released as a milestone ahead of the upcoming GA release. The team is inviting the community to test this milestone and report bugs. A migration guide is available to assist with upgrading.

recent_posts.title: Micronaut 5 adoption of the JSpecify nullability annotations
recent_posts.summary: Micronaut 5 has migrated its internal APIs to use JSpecify nullability annotations, replacing the framework's own `io.micronaut.core.annotation.Nullable` and `NonNull` annotations. Developers upgrading need to update their code to use `org.jspecify.annotations.Nullable` and `org.jspecify.annotations.NonNull`. The post also covers syntax differences for fully qualified types and inner classes, where the annotation placement changes under JSpecify rules.

recent_posts.title: Micronaut framework 5 with Jackson 3
recent_posts.summary: Micronaut Framework 5 upgrades its Jackson Databind module from Jackson 2 to Jackson 3. The post details the package namespace changes required (from com.fasterxml.jackson to tools.jackson), exception class renames, and internal Micronaut class relocations. It also shows how to automate the migration using the OpenRewrite Jackson 2-to-3 recipe with Gradle.

recent_posts.title: Micronaut Framework 5.0 drops support for RxJava 2
recent_posts.summary: Micronaut Framework 5.0, planned for Q2 2026, removes support for RxJava 2. Users must migrate to either Project Reactor or RxJava 3. The migration from RxJava 2 to RxJava 3 requires replacing the dependency from micronaut-rxjava2 to micronaut-rxjava3 and updating import statements for Completable, Flowable, Maybe, and Single types to their RxJava 3 package paths.

recent_posts.title: Micronaut Framework 5.0 supports Kotlin 2.3
recent_posts.summary: Micronaut Framework 5.0, scheduled for Q2 2026, will support Kotlin 2.3. Key Kotlin 2.3 highlights include language improvements (unused return value checker, explicit backing fields), Java 25 support on the JVM, Swift export improvements for Kotlin/Native, new Kotlin/Wasm exception handling defaults, experimental suspend function export for Kotlin/JS, Gradle 9.0 compatibility, and stable time tracking in the standard library.

recent_posts.title: Micronaut Framework 4.10.13 Released!
recent_posts.summary: Micronaut Framework 4.10.13 has been released, including updates to Micronaut Core, Micronaut Sourcegen, and Micronaut SQL. The release addresses two security vulnerabilities: an unbounded formattersCache in TimeConverterRegistrar and an unbounded bundleCache in ResourceBundleMessageSource. Users are strongly urged to upgrade to 4.10.13, or to 3.10.6 if still on Micronaut 3.

recent_posts.title: Micronaut Framework 5.0 supports Apache Groovy 5
recent_posts.summary: Micronaut Framework 5.0, scheduled for release in Q2 2026, will support Apache Groovy 5. The new Groovy 5.0 version brings several improvements including broader JDK support, substantial extension method expansion, enhanced AST transforms, a revamped REPL (groovysh), improved Java interoperability, modern web standards support, type checking enhancements, and additional language features.

recent_posts.title: Micronaut Framework 5.0 with Java 25 baseline
recent_posts.summary: Micronaut Framework 5.0, planned for Q2 2026, will require Java 25 as its minimum baseline. This enables the framework to leverage modern Java features including Virtual Threads, Structured Concurrency, Scoped Values, Pattern Matching for switch, Record Patterns, and String Templates. The shift also brings performance improvements from Java 25, faster CI build times by dropping the multi-version test matrix, and updated documentation samples using modern Java syntax. Major cloud providers (AWS Lambda, AWS Elastic Beanstalk, Google Cloud Functions) already support Java 25, with Azure Functions and Oracle Cloud expected to follow. Users who need Java 17 or 21 support can remain on Micronaut Framework 4.x.

recent_posts.title: Micronaut Framework 4.10.12 Released!
recent_posts.summary: Micronaut Foundation has released Micronaut Framework 4.10.12, which includes updates to Micronaut Core (v4.10.21) and Micronaut Security (v4.15.2). Users still on Micronaut 3 are encouraged to upgrade to version 4.

recent_posts.title: Micronaut Framework 4.10.10 Released!
recent_posts.summary: Micronaut Foundation has released Micronaut Framework 4.10.10, which includes updates to Micronaut Core (v4.10.18) and Micronaut Test (v4.10.3). Users still on older versions are encouraged to upgrade to Micronaut 4.
